subject: pharmacology
title: Cytotoxic Anticancer V: Microtubule Drugs, Vinca Neurotoxicity, Taxane Premedication and Topoisomerase Inhibitors

steps.tx: **Microtubule drugs** attack the spindle from opposite directions to the same mitotic arrest: vinca alkaloids (vincristine, vinblastine, vinorelbine) prevent tubulin polymerisation, taxanes (paclitaxel, docetaxel, cabazitaxel) prevent depolymerisation, freezing the spindle either unbuilt or unbreakable. Their phase specificity (M phase) and neuron toxicity (the axon is a microtubule railway) write both careers, and eribulin and ixabepilone extend the concept into later line breast and other niches.
steps.say: Vincas stop the spindle building, taxanes stop it dismantling; neurons pay both tolls.

left.title: Vinca direction
points: Vinorelbine: oral and IV lung and breast niches

steps.tx: **Vincristine** is neurotoxicity with a dose cap (2 mg adult ceiling tradition) and almost no marrow suppression, which is why it partners myelosuppressive drugs in lymphoma and leukaemia regimens: peripheral neuropathy (lost ankle jerks first), constipation to ileus (autonomic fibres, prophylactic laxatives by protocol), jaw pain and SIADH complete its portrait. Its intrathecal administration is uniformly fatal, the chemotherapy error around which minibag only packaging laws were written.
steps.say: Vincristine spares marrow and bills nerves and bowel; intrathecally it kills without exception.

right.title: Never event engineering
points: Minibags only, never syringes to lumbar trays
Time and place separation from intrathecal drugs

steps.tx: **Vincristine** binds tubulin and arrests the mitotic spindle, yet the bedside problem is nerve injury with almost no marrow suppression. The usual adult ceiling is 2 mg. Spared marrow is why it joins myelosuppressive drugs in lymphoma and leukaemia. Ankle jerks disappear first. Constipation can reach ileus along autonomic fibres, so laxatives are protocol. Jaw pain and SIADH belong on the same list. Injection into the spinal fluid is uniformly fatal.
steps.say: Vincristine freezes the mitotic spindle and is capped near 2 mg in adults because it injures nerves while sparing marrow. Lost ankle reflexes, constipation that can become ileus, jaw pain, and inappropriate antidiuretic hormone are typical. Laxatives start with the protocol. A dose into the spinal fluid is fatal.

vis.alt: A mitotic spindle is frozen in metaphase because microtubules cannot separate the chromosomes.
vis.caption: Chromosomes sit at the midline of a cell whose spindle fibres have stopped shortening, so division cannot finish. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Paclitaxel** arrives in Cremophor EL solvent that bills hypersensitivity (steroid, H1 and H2 premedication rituals, slow first infusions) and dose dense schedules bill cumulative sensory neuropathy and bradycardia, while albumin bound nab paclitaxel deletes the solvent and its rituals for higher drug delivery. Weekly schedules trade peak neuropathy for frequency, and its ovarian, breast and lung crowns make it oncology's most familiar infusion chair.
steps.say: Paclitaxel's solvent demands a premedication ritual; the albumin version fires the solvent.

left.title: Solvent paclitaxel
points: Weekly versus three weekly schedule personalities

right.title: nab-Paclitaxel
points: No Cremophor, no routine steroid premedication

steps.tx: **Docetaxel** bills fluid retention (cumulative capillary leak: pleural effusions and oedema, dexamethasone three day prophylaxis), febrile neutropenia rates demanding growth factor arithmetic, nail and skin changes and lacrimal stenosis, while cabazitaxel inherits prostate cancer after docetaxel failure with diarrhoea and neutropenia ledgers kept under growth factor cover. The taxane sequence in prostate and breast disease is tolerance bookkeeping as much as efficacy.
steps.say: Docetaxel leaks fluid by the litre without its steroid wrapper; cabazitaxel follows where it fails.

left.title: Docetaxel signatures
points: Fluid retention prevented by dexamethasone days
Prostate, breast, lung and gastric regimens

steps.tx: **Topoisomerase inhibitors** trap the enzymes that relieve DNA supercoiling: camptothecins (irinotecan, topotecan) lock topoisomerase I, anthracyclines and etoposide lock topoisomerase II, converting transient single or double strand breaks into lethal collisions with replication forks. Schedule and metabolism write their toxicities (this lesson's next steps), and topoisomerase II's second career as secondary leukaemia author haunts etoposide survivorship.
steps.say: Trap the untwisting enzyme and replication forks crash; the trap's flavour chooses the toxicity.

left.title: Topoisomerase I (camptothecins)
points: Topotecan: ovarian and small cell niches

steps.tx: **Irinotecan** is activated to SN 38 and detoxified by UGT1A1 glucuronidation, so Gilbert syndrome's gene writes its fence from the earlier lesson: early cholinergic diarrhoea (atropine answers) versus late secretory diarrhoea a week later (high dose loperamide protocols, fluids, antibiotics when severe), plus marrow suppression scaled by UGT1A1 star 28 status. Two diarrhoeas, two mechanisms, two treatments is the examination triad.
steps.say: Early diarrhoea gets atropine, late diarrhoea gets loperamide by protocol; UGT1A1 grades both.

nodes.label: Late diarrhoea (days): high dose loperamide schedule
Dehydration or neutropenia: admit, fluids, antibiotics
Next cycle dose reduced, UGT1A1 reviewed

steps.tx: **Etoposide**, the podophyllotoxin, anchors small cell lung (with platinum), germ cell (BEP) and lymphoma salvage regimens by oral and intravenous schedules billing marrow principally, infusion hypotension when pushed fast, alopecia, and the topoisomerase II secondary leukaemia (balanced 11q23 translocations, short latency) that distinguishes its survivorship from alkylator leukaemia's longer fuse. Teniposide retires behind it.
steps.say: Etoposide cures testis and small cell cancers and signs a short fuse leukaemia ledger.

left.title: Etoposide career
points: Oral low dose schedules in palliation

steps.tx: **Extravasation personalities** close the cytotoxic technique syllabus: vinca alkaloids are vesicants treated with warmth and hyaluronidase, taxanes irritate, and every cytotoxic's administration route fence (vincristine never intrathecal, methotrexate intrathecally by design) is engineered with packaging, timing and independent checks after fatal precedents. Oncology nursing protocols are pharmacology written as choreography, and examiners reward knowing which accident each rule commemorates.
steps.say: Every chemotherapy double check commemorates a death; know which accident each rule prevents.

left.title: Vesicant responses
points: Vinca extravasation: stop, aspirate, warm, hyaluronidase

right.title: Route fences
points: Intrathecal agents dispensed separately in time
Oral cytotoxic adherence and storage counselling
